newsitem.title: UK: LIFFE sugar ends higher, Aug firm at expiry.
newsitem.headline: LIFFE sugar ends higher, Aug firm at expiry.

text.p: LIFFE sugar pushed higher during Wednesday evening trading, with the front-month August contract firm at expiry.
Traders said a fund-led rally in New York underpinned the general tone of the market, while belated covering prior to expiry drove August higher.
At the close, August was $10.50 higher at $337.90 a tonne, although the position touched $345.00 at one stage.
The busier October contract closed $5.70 higher at $322.90, while other months were $3.20 to $4.50 up in total turnover of some 5,055 lots.
Although August featured, there had been reasonable underlying support. Poland's flood problems and talk of the possibility of Russian buying were supportive factors, traders said.
In Paris, the ICUMSA October contract closed at $322.00, up $5.50.
